body.name: Sparse hedge-core family
body.construction: Enumerate tuples \(c=(F_0,F_1,A,K_c)\) inside one bidirected district of \(G^{+}\), where \(\varnothing\ne A\subseteq F_0\subsetneq F_1\), \(F_0\cap X=\varnothing\), and \(F_1\cap X\ne\varnothing\). Select one outgoing directed edge toward \(A\) for every vertex of \(F_1\setminus A\), with the selections on \(F_0\setminus A\) retained inside the larger forest; select a bidirected spanning tree of \(F_0\) and extend it to a bidirected spanning tree of \(F_1\). Let \(K_c\) be the uncertain edges in this common selected union, and retain only tuples whose selected edges occur in \(G^{+}\).
